items.title: 5.6.1 Using Excel and Google Sheets for Visualization (Roman Urdu)

source_refs.note: Roman Urdu explanation of Excel and Google Sheets (PDF 148-149).

blocks.text: Excel aur Google Sheets mein data aasani se likha aur bar charts, line graphs, pie charts waghaira banaye ja sakte hain. Chhota maqami karobar har mahine ki sales likh kar chand clicks mein bar chart bana sakta hai ta ke dekhe kis mahine sab se zyada sales hui.

blocks.prompt: Data visualization ke liye MS Excel jaise tools istemal karne ka maqsad kya hai (short question 5)?
blocks.explanation: Yeh kisi ko bhi table mein data rakh kar chand clicks mein, baghair programming ke, wazeh chart banane dete hain, ta ke sab se achhe sales mahine jaise andaaz jaldi dikhe aur share ho; data badalne par charts bhi badal jate hain.

items: Spreadsheets: data likhein, click se chart banayein; jaldi aur aam dastiyab.
